LESSON: SIGNIFICANCE OF TAWHID

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.1: Significance of Tawhid

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Significance of Tawhid. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do Muslims believe in Tawhid?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SIGNIFICANCE OF TAWHID
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Significance of Tawhid helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: SIGNIFICANCE OF TAWHID
Study Significance of Tawhid like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Significance of Tawhid” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Significance of Tawhid is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Significance of Tawhid” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Significance of Tawhid to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Significance of Tawhid from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Significance of Tawhid: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Significance of Tawhid?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do Muslims believe in Tawhid?
2. How is Tawhid manifested in a Muslim?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Significance of Tawhid means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate Tawhid as the basis of the Islamic faith.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
